A.name: gradient_tracking
A.description: Bugs whose root cause is autograd / gradient state: requires_grad, .detach(), .backward(), grad accumulation, no_grad / inference_mode, hook ordering, custom autograd.Function, vmap/functorch grad transforms.

B.name: execution_mode
B.description: Bugs that depend on which execution mode is active: train/eval, eager vs graph/JIT, torch.compile vs eager, tf.function tracing, AutoGraph, mixed precision (autocast/amp).

C.name: distribution_strategy
C.description: Bugs whose root cause is distributed/parallel state: DataParallel, DDP, FSDP, RPC, ProcessGroup, NCCL/Gloo, all_reduce/all_gather/reduce_scatter, MirroredStrategy, MultiWorkerMirroredStrategy, TPUStrategy, ParameterServerStrategy.

D.name: other_state
D.description: Bugs whose root cause is other stateful API surface (not A/B/C): RNG / generator / seed state, BatchNorm running stats, Dropout, optimizer state, LR scheduler state, EMA / running averages, deterministic flags, persistent caches.

E.name: non_state
E.description: Correctness bug not caused by any of the above stateful dimensions: pure shape/dtype/numerics in a stateless op, kernel correctness on a single input, parser/typing/dispatch mismatch, etc.

auxiliary_tags.DUP: duplicate or supersession of another report
